info.title: RepoLens schema-gate fixture
info.description: Not the RepoLens API. This is the smallest valid OpenAPI document that still exercises path, operation, response, and component-schema generation, so schema.test.ts can prove the generator resolves an absolute filesystem path on the host platform before contracts/openapi.json exists. Field naming follows the settled convention (snake_case objects, SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE enum values) so the fixture cannot quietly model a different contract than the real one.
